statement: For the local arrays just specified, the scale-step parameters can be chosen in the order L sufficiently large, then b > 0 sufficiently small, then x∗ > 0. There are constants 0 < λ < 1 and C1 < ∞, independent of the spacing, such that every input with X ≤ x∗ satisfies |m′ − Lm| ≤ C1X2 , Y ′ ≤ λY + C1(|m| + X2 ), X′ ≤ λX + C1( √ W + Y ). (2.8) 7 Primes denote the output coordinates, with charge normalization qLs. For every fixed H > R0, |vH − W| ≤ CHX3 (X ≤ 1). (2.9) Furthermore, fix finite constants A, B. For every sufficiently large fixed H, whenever 0 < z ≤ 1, X ≤ Az, and Y ≤ Bz2, one has v′ H − vH = −2κW2 X y∈Z2: H<|y|≤LH |y|−2 + eHz4 + OH(z5 ). (2.10) Here |eH| is bounded by a deterministic quantity tending to zero as H → ∞. The constants may depend on A, B and the fixed step parameters, but are uniform in the lattice spacing.
